assessment: The authors have discovered that the transcription factor Zfp335 is an important regulator of early T cell development in the thymus. This paper will be of interest to scientists within the field of T cell development. The authors show that Bcl6 and Rorc are direct gene targets of Zfp335 and dysregulation of these are at least partly responsible for the impaired T cell development in Zfp335 mice.
